813-2320-7174.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn or an opponent's upkeep.
Lands you control tap for enough to cast Reset and Personify.
813-2320-7174.description:
Activate all your lands by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast your two spells.
Cast Reset by paying its mana cost, causing you to untap all lands you control.
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages and creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling, and putting Personify into your graveyard as it resolves.
Scholar of the Ages triggers when it enters, returning Reset and Personify to your hand.
Repeat.

579-3812-6723.easyPrerequisites: Simic Ragworm doesn't have summoning sickness.
579-3812-6723.description:
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, adding {U}{U} due to Mana Reflection
Activate Simic Ragworm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3375-3532-5078-7864.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Ravenhill Flock triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5147-5542-6135.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6135.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Aarakocra Sneak from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Aarakocra Sneak enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Aarakocra Sneak.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Aarakocra Sneak token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Aarakocra Sneak token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Aarakocra Sneak trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6135.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

2043-3621-5315.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

280-5702-6763-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
280-5702-6763-6850.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters untapped due to Horizon Explorer, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1456-1482-4195-4574.description:
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2034-3464-4613-4679--128.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to activate the Licid's ability
2034-3464-4613-4679--128.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to activate the Licid's ability.
2034-3464-4613-4679--128.description:
Activate Hyrax Tower Scout using the Licid's ability by paying its activation cost, attaching Hyrax Tower Scout to Yenna and causing Hyrax Tower Scout to become an Aura.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Hyrax Tower Scout.
When the Hyrax Tower Scout token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Hyrax Tower Scout token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-969-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-969-6798.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2919-2999-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-2999-3197.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3389-4050-5043-6753.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}, targeting any creature you control.
Alela triggers, creating two 1/1 Faerie creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Faerie tokens, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2921-3719-6188-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five creatures, excluding Fear of Missing Out, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Fear of Missing Out or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
2921-3719-6188-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping five creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Fear of Missing Out as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Luxurious Locomotive trigger, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Luxurious Locomotive and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

924-2577-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

586-4790-6441.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Priest of Gix that are 6/6 Dinosaurs.
When the Priest of Gix tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding six {B}.
Repeat.

1781-4853-4917-6429.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls four or more nonbasic lands.
1781-4853-4917-6429.description:
Activate Thran Forge by paying {2}, causing Jan Jansen to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing Razorlash Transmogrant.
When Razorlash Transmogrant dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Razorlash Transmogrant by paying {B}{B}, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

942-2523-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Samwise the Stouthearted.
When Samwise the Stouthearted dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Samwise the Stouthearted that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Samwise the Stouthearted token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Samwise the Stouthearted token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1274-2811-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2811-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
When the Servo dies, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2099-2201-2558-5687.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Godhead of Awe, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

147-1223-3967.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
147-1223-3967.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni, Undying Partisan by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.

4050-5011-5326.notablePrerequisites:
Cavalier of Night in exile with a takeover counter on it.
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
4050-5011-5326.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Master, adding one mana of any color.
When The Master dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When The Master enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, doing nothing.
Repeat.

578-1283-1651-3888.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three artifact cards in hand.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
578-1283-1651-3888.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it, causing you to reveal three artifact cards from your hand, and adding at least {6}.
Activate Olivia's Attendants twice by paying {6}, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Olivia's Attendants triggers twice, creating two Blood artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Blood tokens, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.
If you have four or more artifact cards in your hand, this combo nets infinite mana.

2034-4716-4772-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Prosperous Innkeeper, adding {C}{C}.
When Prosperous Innkeeper dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Prosperous Innkeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Prosperous Innkeeper enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

524-2046-2869.description:
Aether Storm prevents any player from casting creature spells.
Avacyn's Memorial prevents Aether Storm from being destroyed due to its ability.

803-3767-3784.notablePrerequisites:
Vhal does not have summoning sickness.
"Sliver" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-3767-3784.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Vhal by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

527-776-2871.notablePrerequisites:
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
Less mana is required if you control a creature with greater than 2 power.
527-776-2871.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding an amount of colored mana equal to the power of the highest power among creatures you control.
Cast Seething Anger with its buyback cost by paying {3}{R}.
Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving your creatures +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving Selvala +3/+0 and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Repeat.
